python3 -c "
# Check plant pot in obs_0033:
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0033.png'))

pot_rows = []
for c in range(380, 510):
    for r in range(511, 450, -1):
        if img[r, c, 0] > 100 and img[r, c, 1] < 100 and img[r, c, 2] < 50:
            pot_rows.append((c, r))
            break

print('Pot bottom points in obs_0033:', len(pot_rows))
if pot_rows:
    max_r = max(p[1] for p in pot_rows)
    print('Max row:', max_r)
    pts = [p for p in pot_rows if p[1] == max_r]
    print('Bottom pts count at max_r:', len(pts), 'cols:', [p[0] for p in pts[:10]])
    u_center = np.mean([p[0] for p in pts])
    print(f'u_center = {u_center:.2f}, v = {max_r}')
"
